dedupe_keys.name: korea architecture hub 건축hub building register open api 건축물대장정보 서비스

description: This open API from Korea's Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport serves the national building register (건축물대장) through the Architecture HUB, the building services industry information system. It returns the register's attribute sections: basic outline, general title, title section, floor outlines, attached lots, exclusive and common areas, sewage treatment facilities, housing prices, exclusive units and zoning districts, in XML or JSON. Building data by type that the older architecture data open system (Seumteo) used to provide are now served through the Architecture HUB. Coverage: all registered buildings in South Korea. Access: free through the public data portal with an API key; development accounts get 10,000 calls a day and more on request. Licence: no restriction on use. Caveats: register attributes, not geometry; the portal reset connections several times while reading, so bulk use needs retries. Simulation uses are national building exposure models with structure, floors, use and age, and floor area inputs for energy and occupancy models. Related records: the Architecture HUB building energy API and the Korea prototypical office energy policy case study.
